title: Security Intelligence — routing, grounding & non-fabrication
description: Locally-authored cases exercising the Part 3/5 deterministic router + grounded answer format: exact CVE/CWE/CAPEC/ATT&CK/D3FEND identifier resolution (both real, verified-present ids sampled live from the installed knowledge base, and known-fake ids for the non-fabrication gate), vulnerability-filter/detection/mitigation/incident-response/cloud topic routing, and prompt-injection-resistance probes. Extended with real NIST CSF/SP 800-53/SSDF/Privacy-baseline control identifiers sampled live from the installed database, plus compliance/standards topic coverage (SLSA, SPDX, OpenSSF, Sigstore, OAuth/TLS/DKIM/DMARC RFCs) and new detection-source questions. Extended further with real GHSA/OSV identifiers sampled live from the installed database (GHSA reviewed-advisory corpus + npm/PyPI/Go/RubyGems/crates.io/Packagist/NuGet OSV ecosystems), package/ecosystem vulnerability queries, KEV/EPSS/CVSS-provenance checks, and new detection-source (Splunk/Falco/Zeek/Suricata) and Azure cloud-security topic coverage. Final pass: broader compliance/detection/mitigation/incident-response/cloud/general topic coverage, more real GHSA (including withdrawn) and npm-ecosystem OSV identifiers, additional fake-identifier and prompt-injection cases — brings the suite to 450+. Cycle V5 pass: version_check and prioritization route coverage, Red Hat CSAF-enriched CVEs, Debian/Alpine/OSS-Fuzz OSV identifiers, distro-fix cross-references, CVSS v4 cases, Entra/AWS/detection-pack topic coverage, additional fake-identifier and injection cases.

governance.identifier_samples_source: live installed knowledge base at suite-generation time
